data.narrative:
Red 6 is a Series B+ stage defense and security company that has raised over $100M to date. The comparable universe consists of 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers operating in Defense & Security, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The Defense & Security sector contains 24 same-sector peers overall, but filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies yields fewer than three datapoints in each category—below the threshold required for statistical reliability. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given Red 6's specialized market position and stage.

Given the sparse comparability set and the inapplicability of quantitative triangulation, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range at this time. Further work is needed to either (1) expand the peer set through proprietary intelligence on private defense-tech fundraises at comparable stages, (2) rely on bottom-up DCF methods if financial projections are available, or (3) assess transaction multiples from recent M&A activity in the narrower defense-tech subsector. The key uncertainty remains the absence of sufficient narrow-band peers with disclosed valuations at Red 6's stage and market positioning.
